human_question: Does the patient fulfil all stabilisation criteria (SBP, i.v. diuretics, vasodilators, inotropes) at randomisation?
label: Stabilised
text: Stabilisation: SBP ≥100 mmHg and no symptomatic hypotension in the preceding 6 h; no increase in i.v. diuretic dose for 6 h; no i.v. vasodilators for 6 h; no i.v. inotropes for 24 h.
